reviewer: Codex full-page visual collation; public-domain excerpts with punctuation/ellipsis added. No expert approval.

sections.text: 何謂救應，如官逢傷而透印以解之。
sections.scope: 官格 is a premise. 透印 is a visible-stem observation; actual 傷/解 and relative strength remain unproved.

sections.text: 七煞逢食制而又逢印，逢財以去印存食。
sections.scope: 七煞 frame, effective 食制, intervening 印 harm, and effective 財去印 are separate premises.

sections.text: 財逢劫而透食以化之，生官以制之。
sections.scope: Two alternative routes; the implemented observation uses the 生官以制 route only. Presence does not prove control.

sections.text: 此八字妙用，全在成敗救應，其中權輕權重，甚是活變。
sections.scope: No universal rescue priority or numeric weights are given.

sections.text: 既化矣，又論化神。……再見甲乙，亦不作爭合妒合論。蓋真化矣。……歲運遇之，皆閒神也。
sections.scope: Already true transformation is the premise, not something proved by the exception itself. Keep natal chart versus subsequent 운 context separate.

sections.text: 只知逢龍而化，不知逢五而化。辰龍之說，供引之意。
sections.scope: An explanation of the five starting-stem progressions, not a universal literal 辰-presence or preferred-hour test for 旺氣.

sections.text: 非化斯神，喜見斯神，執一而論也。是化象亦要究其衰旺，審其虛實，察其喜忌。……如化神旺而有餘，宜洩化神之神為用；化神衰而不足，宜生助化神之神為用。
sections.scope: Strength of the transformed qi after transformation, not an automatic classification of the original day stem or a scalar threshold.

transformationCases.text: 年月兩干之甲乙，得當令之申金、丑內之辛金制住，不起爭妒之風。時干己土臨旺，與日主親切而合，合神真實，乃謂真化。但秋金當令，化神洩氣不足。
attributedPremises: 甲乙得申金及丑內辛金制住，不起爭妒之風
己土臨旺，與日主親切而合

transformationCases.text: 甲木生於季秋，土旺乘權，剋去壬水，又無比劫，合神更真，化氣有餘。
壬水生於仲春，化象斯真，最喜其甲木元神透露。化氣有餘，餘則宜洩。
此與前造只換一卯字，化象更真，化神更有餘。

normalizations: Printed chart columns read right to left: year, month, day, hour. These are edition-specific source cases, not verified birth records.
官 -> 正官, 七煞 -> 偏官, 傷 -> 傷官, 食 -> 食神; unqualified 印/財 preserve both polarity classes under the pinned research terminology.
Static monthly hidden-stem candidates do not establish 月令用神/格局. Only visible non-day stems fill 透/actor observations.
Source case attribution, conditional rescue, before/after transformation and cross-person effects are distinct layers.
